---
title: "DepCens-Audit Report"
output:
  html_document: default
  pdf_document: default
  word_document: default
params:
  audit: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
audit <- params$audit
```

## Scope and wording discipline

This report is **diagnostic**: it describes how strongly the observed data
constrain the analysis outputs. It does **not** judge regulatory compliance,
and it does not make cross-dimensional performance claims (Phase A release).

## Flags (two-layer report)

```{r flags}
fmt_flag <- function(f) {
  data.frame(level = toupper(f$level), dimension = f$dimension,
             layer = f$layer, code = f$code, message = f$message,
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
root_flags <- if (inherits(audit, "depcens_audit")) audit$flags$root else audit$flags$root
if (length(root_flags)) {
  knitr::kable(do.call(rbind, lapply(root_flags, fmt_flag)))
} else {
  cat("No root-cause flags raised.\n")
}
```

```{r perf}
perf <- if (inherits(audit, "depcens_audit")) audit$flags$overall else audit$flags$performance[[1]]
cat(sprintf("Overall performance flag: **[%s] %s**\n\n", toupper(perf$level), perf$code))
cat(perf$message)
```

## PSA mapping

```{r psa}
psa <- audit$psa
cat(sprintf("- strategy: `%s`\n", psa$strategy))
cat(sprintf("- base case: %s\n", psa$base_case))
cat(sprintf("- sampling: %s\n", psa$sampling))
cat(sprintf("- sensitivity layer: %s\n\n", psa$sensitivity_layer))
cat("Required reporting outputs:\n\n")
for (r in psa$reporting) cat(sprintf("- %s\n", r))
cat(sprintf("\n_Diagnostic wording_: %s\n", psa$diagnostic_wording))
```

## Dimension details

```{r dims, results='asis'}
dims <- if (inherits(audit, "depcens_audit")) audit$dimensions else list(audit)
for (nm in names(dims)) {
  cat(sprintf("\n### %s\n\n", nm))
  d <- dims[[nm]]
  if (inherits(d, "depcens_extrapolation_audit")) {
    m <- d$metrics
    knitr::kable(data.frame(
      model = names(m$rmst_full),
      rmst_full = signif(m$rmst_full, 4),
      rmst_truncated_refit = signif(m$rmst_trunc, 4),
      rho_instability = signif(m$rho_instability_per_model, 3)))
    cat(sprintf(
      paste0("\n\nrho instability (max): %.3f | rho maturity: %.3f | ",
             "model disagreement: %.3f | truncation point t* = %.2f | ",
             "horizon = %.1f | best model (AIC): %s\n"),
      m$rho_instability, m$rho_maturity, m$model_disagreement,
      m$t_star, m$horizon, m$best_model_by_aic))
  } else if (inherits(d, "depcens_positivity_audit")) {
    knitr::kable(d$sensitivity)
    cat(sprintf("\n\nSensitivity interval for S(tau=%.3g): [%.3f, %.3f]\n",
                d$tau, d$interval[1], d$interval[2]))
    cat(sprintf("\n_%s_\n", d$meta$note))
  } else if (inherits(d, "depcens_evaluation_audit")) {
    cat(sprintf("\nIPCW IBS: %.4f\n", d$ibs))
    knitr::kable(head(d$brier, 10))
    cat(sprintf("\n_%s_\n", d$meta$status))
  }
}
```

## Reproducibility metadata

```{r meta}
meta <- audit$meta
cat(sprintf("- audit time: %s\n", meta$audit_time))
if (!is.null(meta$seed)) cat(sprintf("- seed: %s\n", meta$seed))
if (!is.null(meta$config_version))
  cat(sprintf("- threshold set version: %s\n", meta$config_version))
if (!is.null(meta$data_fingerprint))
  cat(sprintf("- input data fingerprint: %s\n", meta$data_fingerprint))
cat(sprintf("- R version: %s\n", R.version.string))
```
